lively_eyes.command.loading: Your skin has not loaded yet. Try again in a second.
lively_eyes.command.found: Eyes found on your skin's face: right eye at %1$s, left eye at %2$s (score %3$s).%4$s
lively_eyes.command.not_found: No eyes found on your skin: %s. It stays without expressions.
lively_eyes.failure.not_64x64: the skin is not 64x64 (HD skins are left out)
lively_eyes.failure.no_skin_tone: the face has no clear skin tone (mask or helmet?)
lively_eyes.failure.no_pair: there are no two mirrored eyes on the face
lively_eyes.failure.too_weak: the best guess was too weak
lively_eyes.configuration.title: Lively Eyes
lively_eyes.configuration.enabled.toolti: Turns every expression on or off.
lively_eyes.configuration.blink.tooltip: Blinks now and then, sometimes twice in a row.
lively_eyes.configuration.gaze.tooltip: Eyes follow whoever is close and glance sideways now and then. Only on skins whose eye has white and iris side by side.
lively_eyes.configuration.hurt.tooltip: Squeezes the eyes shut when taking damage.
lively_eyes.configuration.tired.tooltip: At 3 hearts, blinks more and, on 2-row eyes, half-closes.
lively_eyes.menu.title: Expressions
lively_eyes.menu.hint: Click one and your face shows it for 3 seconds (only you see it).
lively_eyes.configuration.anger.tooltip: Angry brows while hitting something with a mob or player in front.
lively_eyes.configuration.cry.tooltip: At 2 hearts or less, a tear runs down and the eyes half-close.
lively_eyes.configuration.blush.tooltip: Red cheeks and eyes looking away with another player very close, face to face.
lively_eyes.configuration.surprise.toolt: Wide eyes when on fire or falling fast.
lively_eyes.configuration.happy.tooltip: Smiling closed eyes and rosy cheeks while eating or drinking.
lively_eyes.configuration.cold.tooltip: Bluish cheeks and narrowed eyes while freezing in powder snow.
